program: Home repair, disaster readiness and community recovery
priceScope: Conditional annual whole-recipient cost divided by a limited modeled local channel; not a verified marginal gift offer or complete portfolio EV

what: West Street Recovery repairs disaster-damaged homes in Northeast Houston.
It also equips neighborhood disaster-response hubs and supports resident-led organizing and research.
The work combines practical recovery assistance with efforts to improve drainage and public disaster aid.
strengths: Repair work addresses unsafe homes and loss of essential water access.
Local survivor and contractor participation connects recovery work with community capacity.
Original financial returns separate repair activity from organizing and broader services.
reservations: Historical unique homes and cumulative families do not establish current annual completed repairs.
Clinical changes and actual avoided household expenditure are not causally measured.
Organizing, disaster aid, partner labor and marginal cash capacity require distinct attribution.

sections.what: West Street Recovery repairs disaster-damaged homes in Northeast Houston. It also equips neighborhood disaster-response hubs and supports resident-led organizing and research. The work combines practical recovery assistance with efforts to improve drainage and public disaster aid.
sections.monitoring: The 2023 year-in-review self-report gives over50 unique homes,32 restored-water families, one full rebuild and two large projects. Its CMS date is February2022 despite a2023 narrative; publication vintage is inconsistent. Current service copy gives28 studs-up repairs,130 water restorations and300 families since2017, all cumulative. Do not add overlapping counts. Request recent dated completions, residual hazards, household costs and follow-up.
sections.qualitative: Repair work addresses unsafe homes and loss of essential water access. Local survivor and contractor participation connects recovery work with community capacity. Original financial returns separate repair activity from organizing and broader services. Historical unique homes and cumulative families do not establish current annual completed repairs. Clinical changes and actual avoided household expenditure are not causally measured. Organizing, disaster aid, partner labor and marginal cash capacity require distinct attribution. Original FY2024 return confirms West Street Recovery, EIN82-2708194, Houston. Current official donate page embeds Donorbox and links PayPal; no transaction performed.
sections.cost: The conditional annual partial-channel reference is $157.93 million per ten combined healthy-year welfare equivalents: 0.097278 clinical QALYs and 0.057712 signed resource equivalents. $10,000 corresponds to 0.000633 combined equivalents under proportional annual accounting, not demonstrated next-gift response. Full annual recognized recipient cost is $2,447,774. Historical-reference judgment50 annual unique repair-household opportunities, not current annual measured completions. Alternative aid, contractors, insurance and family replacement leave annual additional response .4, yielding20 exposed households. Clinical response .3, utility .02 for one year and full union harm .001 are unsupported safety/comfort priors, not mortality estimates. Resource success .5 gives$1,000 otherwise-paid repair, temporary displacement or care expenditure genuinely avoided after insurance, transfers and maintenance. Positive overlap .5 then full$100 process/time burden yields$400 for successful households and minus$100 for others. Property appreciation, full retail repair value and local contractor payments are not extra net household income. Union 20 household proxies contains clinical subgroup 6; no separate clinical population is added. One welfare-equivalent adult per household at $25,000 annual consumption, with components netted before one log. Positive components alone receive overlap adjustment; negative components, all unavoidable costs and union harms remain full. Clinical failure retains resource exposures and burdens. ResourceYears is fraction of one year’s gain, not repeated lifetime payments. No retail medicines, gross salaries, ordinary survivor earnings or property wealth are counted. Outside volunteers, contractors paid elsewhere and public relief opportunity costs are unknown centrally; explicit larger-cost/provider-loss cases preserve their possible incidence. Policy and organizing benefits are unknown and omitted from this partial-channel reference, not judged zero. Central partner/payer zero is unknown-neutral, not observed zero or complete world net benefit. Other programs and external opportunity costs remain unknown; whole recipient cost versus this narrow channel is not complete portfolio EV or a marginal gift offer.
sections.funding: FY2024 original whole recipient functional expense$2,447,774; no populated netted event or inventory expenses. FY2023$1,172,801 and FY2022$1,103,993 are original prior-year cost references. FY2024 repair program expense$861,109 is not the whole recipient denominator; voter engagement$323,352 and other services explain why this repair-only model is not total portfolio EV. Unknown donated labor and government-incidence costs prevent a complete social-cost claim.

model.costScope: Whole annual recognized recipient cost versus conditional repair safety and net household-resource channel; policy and other programs unknown
model.geographicAttribution: Northeast Houston repair channel; judged .98 metro share once
model.formula: Union=N*unique*b; clinical=union*completion*q*discounted finite years minus full union harms. Financial=.5*people*discounted one-year log(1+joint net gain/baseline), local share once. Headline=10*C/(clinical+financial).
model.counterfactual: Public disaster aid, insurance, paid contractors, other nonprofits and family recovery retained
model.attribution: Annual incremental recipient response is distinct from cohort deduplication and geographic share; no claim of whole annual portfolio or marginal donation causal effect.
model.uncertainty: Source-grounded original cost/services; all causal mapping, utility and net resource priors unsupported. Complete portfolio and marginal donor EV unknown.
model.nativeOutcomes: Completed safer homes and actual household costs avoided, not cumulative repairs, public appropriations or contractor revenue
